objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

objects.taxonomy_description: A toroidal pastry characterized by a central hole and typically glazed or topped.
